claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.targetRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk normally targets up to 10 creatures, but the ring restricts casting to the wearer only. The current grant_spell_access atom has no field to express this target restriction. Without it, the encoded trace implies unconstrained targeting, which misrepresents the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you cast Water Walk from it, targeting only yourself.
